question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Siddhartha, Bob gets Dune, and Claire gets Middlemarch.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Claire swap books. Then, Claire and Alice swap books. Finally, Claire and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Siddhartha
(B) Dune
(C) Middlemarch
solution:
Book order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: Siddhartha | Dune | Middlemarch
1. Alice–Claire: Middlemarch | Dune | Siddhartha
2. Claire–Alice: Siddhartha | Dune | Middlemarch
3. Claire–Alice: Middlemarch | Dune | Siddhartha
Claire has Siddhartha, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
